rics.description: Total Tourism-Related Output, Passenger air transportation
rics.meaning: Total tourism-related output for passenger air transportation. BEA Travel & Tourism Satellite Accounts, annual.
rics.how_to_use: Long-run tourism trend gauge. Combine with monthly TSA throughput for high-frequency cross-check. Sensitive to fuel costs and consumer discretionary.

rics.description: Total sales of tourism Industries total
rics.meaning: Total tourism industry sales — quarterly aggregate of all tourism-related sectors.
rics.how_to_use: Headline tourism cycle gauge. Watch alongside leisure & hospitality payrolls (in employment_hours) and consumer confidence for the broader services consumer view.

rics.description: Total sales of tourism Industries, passenger air transportation
rics.meaning: Total sales of passenger air transportation within tourism industries — quarterly.
rics.how_to_use: Most cyclical tourism sub-line. Compare against airline industry revenues (BTS) and the TSA throughput series for a real-time cross-check.

rics.description: Total sales of tourism Industries, traveler accommodations
rics.meaning: Total sales of traveler accommodations (hotels, motels, B&Bs) within tourism industries — quarterly.
rics.how_to_use: Pair with RevPAR and occupancy rate from STR/CBRE for sector-level depth. Sensitive to business travel cycles, not just leisure.

rics.meaning: TSA airport security checkpoint throughput — count of passengers screened. Daily; aggregated monthly here.
rics.how_to_use: Highest-frequency travel demand indicator. Use as a real-time cross-check on tourism / leisure consumer spend. Compare YoY to control for seasonality.

rics.meaning: TSA Checkpoint Traveler Throughput — same as aUSTRTTP, alternate series with adjustments.
rics.how_to_use: Use whichever has cleaner recent prints. Watch the YoY % change for trend; the level is heavily seasonal.
